typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and thin, horizontal serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (similar to Didot or Bodoni), which was prevalent in French academic and formal printing during the 19th century.
